## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix slug generation because titles made entirely of non-ASCII letters can produce empty URL segments. Add the verification section required by contributor policy.

## Changes

The pull request adds a helper that lowercases page titles, replaces runs of characters outside ASCII letters and digits with hyphens, and trims boundary hyphens. It adds parameterized tests for normalization and empty results.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- app/slug.py:7 — correctness — Preserve Unicode letters and digits in slugs — `slugify("東京")` returns `""` because `[^a-z0-9]+` replaces both letters with a hyphen that the next line strips. The pull-request description specifies replacing non-alphanumeric characters. — A page titled `東京` gets no title-derived URL segment.
- PR body — correctness — Add the required testing section — The submitted description omits `## Testing`. `AGENTS.md:4` requires “Every pull-request description has a `## Testing` section that says how the change was verified.” — Reviewers cannot tell from the description how you verified the change.

## Suggestions

- app/slug.py:7 — tests — Test digit preservation in page titles — `Page 2` exercises the digit-preservation path, but none of the cases in `test_slugify` contains a digit, and the existing smoke test only imports `app`. — A regression that gives `Page 2` and `Page` the same slug would pass the suite. — Fix: Extend `test_slugify` with a numbered title.
